name: fifo8
title: Coal-FIFO8 — 8x8 synchronous FIFO
description: Build an 8-deep, 8-bit-wide synchronous FIFO with write/read enables and full/empty flags. Testbench prints fifo8:PASS.
context: Simple circular buffer, depth 8. wr push (when not full), rd pop (when not empty); dout shows the current head (first-out) combinationally. empty=1 when count==0, full=1 when count==8. count is internal 4-bit. Testbench: reset -> empty=1; write 8'hAA then read and CHECK dout=8'hAA; fill 8 entries CHECK full=1; drain CHECK empty=1. print fifo8:PASS.

manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input wr, input rd, input [7:0] din, output [7:0] dout, output reg full, output reg empty
manifest.behavior: after reset empty=1,full=0; wr=1 with din=AA then rd=1 -> dout=AA; after 8 pushes full=1; after draining all empty=1. print fifo8:PASS if correct.
